Book a Free 30-Minute Audit
What does SAGED.AI specialize in?
AI-driven business transformation for small and medium-sized businesses — conversational AI, agentic AI, workflow automation, predictive analytics, and business intelligence, applied to streamline operations and scale profitability.
Everyone already uses AI. Why do I need help?
Because adoption and results aren't the same thing. 77% of US small businesses now use AI regularly, but only about 8% reach advanced adoption — the rest are running one or two tools without a strategy behind them. Research from Goldman Sachs and the SBA Office of Advocacy both find that outcomes track with implementation, not with whether you bought the software.
What is AI Search Visibility, and why does it matter now?
45% of consumers now use AI assistants to find local businesses — up from 6% a year ago — but barely 1% of local businesses actually get recommended by them. When someone asks ChatGPT or Gemini for a provider in your category, you are either named or you are invisible. It's the same shift SEO caused twenty years ago, happening faster.
What is Agentic AI, and how does it benefit my business?
Agentic AI doesn't just answer — it acts. It plans and executes multi-step work on its own: following up on leads, booking appointments, updating your CRM, and running workflows end to end without a person handing off between steps.
How is this different from a regular chatbot?
Traditional chatbots follow rigid scripts and break the moment a customer says something unexpected. Conversational AI understands language, context, and intent, is trained on your own material, and handles bookings and lead capture inside the same conversation — improving as it goes.
My team already uses ChatGPT. Isn't that enough?
It's a start, but it's usually inconsistent. Roughly three in four small businesses using AI say they need more training, and fewer than one in four have received any. Most have no shared approach at all — so results vary by person and by day. Enablement turns individual experimentation into something the whole team can repeat and rely on.
Is AI hard to implement in a smaller business?
Not with the right partner. Most of what we build integrates with tools you already use — website, calendar, CRM, social channels. Implementation is handled for you from setup through launch, starting with the highest-impact area so you see results early.
How do I get started?
1. Book a free consultation to talk through your challenges and goals. 2. We assess your operation and propose a tailored strategy. 3. We implement, integrate, and measure the impact. 4. We support and optimize as the business grows.

Privacy & Your Information
What we collect

If you use the assistant on this site, we collect only what you choose to type into it — typically your name, email address, phone number, industry, what you are trying to achieve, and when you plan to start. We do not ask for financial account details, government identification numbers, or passwords, and you should never enter them.

Why we collect it

To answer your question and, where you have asked us to, to follow up about working together. We do not sell your information, rent it, or share it with advertisers.

Where it goes

Conversations and the details above are stored in our customer platform and in a private spreadsheet accessible only to SAGED.AI. The assistant is powered by a third-party AI provider, which processes your messages to generate replies. Your conversation may be reviewed by our team to respond to you and to improve how the assistant answers.

How long we keep it

We keep inquiry records for as long as needed to respond and maintain our business relationship. You can ask us to delete your information at any time.

Your choices

You can use this site without talking to the assistant. You can decline any question it asks and still get help. To see, correct, or delete what we hold about you, contact us and we will action it.

Cookies and site storage

This site stores your light or dark theme preference in your browser. We do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.

A note on AI

The assistant is an AI tool, not a person, and it can occasionally be wrong. Nothing it says is a binding quote, a guarantee of results, or legal, financial, tax or medical advice. For anything that matters, speak with our team directly.
